_README: Zone boundary values from ISO 10816-3 (broadband velocity, 10-1000 Hz,
RMS, mm/s), measured on non-rotating parts.
These are hardcoded rather than retrieved on purpose. A retrieval miss or
a reranker reordering must never be able to turn a Zone C verdict into a
Zone B one. The ingested standard PDF supplies the prose - the group
definitions and the recommended actions - which the answer cites; the
Boundary convention: a value exactly ON a boundary belongs to the LOWER
zone. 2.80 -> B, 2.81 -> C. iso10816.py states this in its output.
ISO 20816-3:2022 supersedes ISO 10816-3:2009 with the same velocity zone
limits, so both map to the same table and only the cited name differs.
The displacement (micrometre) columns of the standard are NOT transcribed
here. They apply to Groups 1 and 2 only and must be taken from the
ingested PDF rather than from memory - see displacement_zone() which

1.name: Large machines
1.description: Rated power above 300 kW and up to 50 MW; electrical machines with shaft height H >= 315 mm.

2.name: Medium machines
2.description: Rated power above 15 kW up to and including 300 kW; electrical machines with shaft height 160 mm <= H < 315 mm.

3.name: Pumps with separate driver
3.description: Pumps with multivane impeller and separate driver (centrifugal, mixed flow or axial flow), rated power above 15 kW.

4.name: Pumps with integrated driver
4.description: Pumps with multivane impeller and integrated driver (centrifugal, mixed flow or axial flow), rated power above 15 kW.

A.action: No action. Vibration is characteristic of a machine in as-new condition.

B.action: No action required. Continue routine monitoring at the normal interval.

C.action: Machine may be operated for a limited period only. Investigate the cause and plan remedial action at the next suitable opportunity. Increase monitoring frequency.

D.meaning: Vibration severe enough to cause damage.
D.action: Do not continue operating. Vibration at this level is normally sufficient to cause damage; shut down and correct the fault.
